summary: Allows teachers or authorized personnel to update the height and weight records for students, typically on a class-wise basis.
steps: Select the 'Class' and 'Section' (if applicable) for which the updates are needed.
Choose whether to update 'Height' or 'Weight' from the available options.
The system will fetch the student details for the selected class/section.
Enter the new height or weight values for the respective students in the editable fields.
A successful message will confirm the update.
business_rules: Teachers are typically responsible for updating the height and weight records for students in their assigned classes.
important_notes: Users can choose to update either height or weight, or both, but the selection is made before fetching data.
The data displayed is specific to the selected class and section.
